name: NEGATIVE//EDGE
source:
A visual novel about feeling desired

about having something to blame

about doing anything for your partner

[Edited from [url=https://crambleberry.itch.io/negativeedge]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部關於感受自己被人渴望的視覺小說。

關於找到能歸咎於它的事物。

關於願意為伴侶做任何事。

［改編自[url=https://crambleberry.itch.io/negativeedge]itch.io[/url]］
